# Southern Highlands Painters

> Family-run residential and commercial painting business based in Bundanoon, NSW, servicing the Southern Highlands region. Run by Dan Eaton, a licensed painter (NSW Painting Contractors Licence 168818C) with 25 years of local experience. Services include interior and exterior house painting, roof painting (iron, Colorbond and tiled), floor painting, and commercial/industrial painting.

## Services

- [Residential House Painting](https://southernhighlandspainter.com.au/residential-house-painting.html): Interior and exterior house painting.
- [Commercial & Industrial Painting](https://southernhighlandspainter.com.au/commercial-painting.html): Painting for offices, retail spaces and industrial premises.
- [Roof Painting](https://southernhighlandspainter.com.au/iron-tiled-roof-painting.html): Iron, Colorbond and tiled roof painting and sealing.
- [Floor Painting](https://southernhighlandspainter.com.au/floor-painting.html): Residential, commercial and industrial floor coatings.
